label: At D2, strongly negative after a1 reaching S2 (rare); higher after a2; lower when S1 believed good.
terms: (phase == D2) * (action == 1) * (state == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) ;; (phase == D2) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D2) * (action == 2) * (state == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_action == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 1 is near +1 at D1/GO (tiny belief-dependent shifts) and varies almost entirely at D2. At D2 it depends on the just-made choice and the reached state (both observed at D2): a1 -> S2 (rare) drives it far negative (weight ~ -0.97), a2 raises it (~ +0.23, a bit more for a2 -> S1 rare), a1 -> S1 sits in between. It is additionally lowered in proportion to the observer log-odds that S1 is good (belief_lo). The free fit adds small GO/D1 belief terms and previous-trial terms, gaining only ~0.014 dev R^2. No future variables used.

issues: Label implies 'after' (previous trial) for a1->S2, but the term is this trial's choice and reached state at D2. The agent can see both at D2, so this is fine, but the wording is ambiguous.
Label does not say that n sits near +1 with almost no variation at D1/GO. Minor omission.

misses shows a moderate systematic previous-trial effect at D2: under-predicted after a1 S2 r by +0.22 and after a2 S1 r by +0.13, over-predicted after unrewarded trials by about -0.08. The free fit's last_is/prev terms only gain about 0.016 test R^2, so this is a small effect, not a large error class.

Each term is needed: without belief_lo test R^2 is 0.809; without the a2 term it is 0.796; a separate action/state split (not the a1&S2 conjunction) gives only 0.534. Swapping belief_lo for belief, tanh(belief_lo), state2*belief_lo, a1*belief_lo, prev_reward-gated belief_lo or belief_lo*belief_cover always scores worse (0.81-0.84). (D2)*(a2)*ep_dec gives 0.856, essentially a tie (+0.002), so I kept the recorded form.
Profile confirms the claims: D2 residual by choice x state is a1S1 -0.14, a1S2 -1.12, a2S1 +0.46, a2S2 +0.30. The D2 belief-decile residual is monotone, +0.40 down to -0.57.
skeptic.revised_label: Near +1 except at D2: very negative for a1->S2, higher for a2, lower when S1 is believed good.
